orbifold.name: T2/Z2
orbifold.note: the 6D SU(4) gauge-Higgs unification of arXiv:2312.08608, whose weak mixing angle comes out sin^2(theta_W) = 1/4 at the compactification scale

source.papers: Parts III-V of the series; the model is AHMN, arXiv:2312.08608
source.chain: both files are generated by ghu-explorer/tools/make_calc_data.py, which fails a row that disagrees with Part IV's Proposition 1 or whose character no (p,q,r) reproduces

calibration_note: none: this model's potential is built from reps_modes and the role = -1 adjoint row. The July tool's fitted gauge weight (wg = 0.35, calibrated to AHMN's own minimum) is NOT used by this kernel and is not carried.
note: (m,q) histograms for SU(4) irreps, m = n2-n4, q = n3 mod 2; gauge is the calibrated VEV-dependent adjoint list with weight wg.
